# A book kept in CAD that borrowed US dollars into its Canadian bank.
#
# Every top-level account is held in CAD, so the book is kept in CAD (Q-042).
# The loan is the one foreign thing in it:
#
# - Assets:CAD Bank: 1,300.00 CAD, the money the loan put there on 01-03.
# - Liabilities:USD Loan: 1,000.00 USD owed, drawn at 1.30 CAD/USD, so the
#   book carries it at 1,300.00 CAD.
# - Prices: USD in CAD 1.30 on 01-02 and 1.40 on 02-02.
#
# What this fixture is for: the liability half of a balance sheet's unrealized
# gains. A loan whose two splits are both in US dollars states no CAD figure,
# so what it cost and what it is worth are the same number and the liability
# terms cancel. Borrowed with CAD, they do not: by 2026-01-25 GnuCash's nearest
# price is the 02-02 rate of 1.40, so 1,000.00 USD owed is worth C$1,400.00
# against the C$1,300.00 it was drawn at, and the book owes 100.00 CAD more
# than it borrowed.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:USD Loan
	type: "Liability"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "13/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "14/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-03 * "Borrow 1,000.00 USD into the Canadian bank"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1300.00 CAD
	Liabilities:USD Loan -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.30"
		value: "-1300.00"
